personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT with 1 iOS-Native Clean structure
personality_one_liner: Warm artisan pizza delivery with creamy tones, burnt orange flame accents, and wood-fired editorial typography.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like vertical padding, comfortable touch targets, sticky bottom action bar with safe area inset.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky category header filters
Use glass overlay on hero artisan banner with 75% surface tint
Use glass bottom tab bar over scrolling content
dont's: Never blur list items or form fields
Never allow low contrast text on glass

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Browse artisan categories, featured wood-fired pizzas, quick access to custom pizza builder and cart.

states.loading: Centered warm spinner with flame accent
states.empty: Warm illustration of empty oven with 'No wood-fired pizzas found' and reset filters button
states.error: Friendly error message with retry button and fallback menu

screens.layout: Hero banner with wood-fired oven photography and gradient scrim, horizontal category pills (All, Neapolitan, Wood-Fired, Vegan, Sides, Drinks), promotional builder banner, vertical list of artisan pizza cards with pricing and quick Add button.

screens.name: Menu
screens.purpose: Detailed searchable category browsing with filtering for dietary and crust options.

states.loading: Skeleton card placeholders with warm cream shimmer
states.empty: Empty state with search reset and popular recommendations
states.error: Network error banner with retry action

screens.layout: Sticky top search bar with filter chips, scrollable category tabs, two-column or full-width editorial pizza cards with high-res food photography.

screens.name: CustomPizzaBuilder
screens.purpose: Interactive Domino's-style custom pizza builder where users choose size, crust, sauce, cheese, and toppings.

states.empty: Select a size to start building your master pizza
states.error: Error saving custom recipe, retry button

screens.layout: Step-by-step interactive builder: 1. Select Size (Personal, Medium, Large), 2. Choose Crust (Artisan Sourdough, Thin Crispy, Stuffed Crust), 3. Sauce & Cheese, 4. Toppings grid with live price calculator and sticky 'Add Custom Pizza to Cart' bottom button.

screens.name: Cart
screens.purpose: Review selected items, adjust quantities, apply promo codes, and proceed to checkout.

states.empty: Warm empty cart illustration with 'Your oven is cold! Add a delicious artisan pizza to begin.' and 'Browse Menu' CTA

screens.layout: Itemized list with quantity steppers, special instructions input, delivery fee breakdown, promo code input, and sticky bottom checkout bar with total price.

screens.name: Checkout
screens.purpose: Select saved delivery address, confirm Cash on Delivery payment, and place order.

states.empty: Add a delivery address to proceed
states.error: Address validation error, correct and retry

screens.layout: Saved address selector with map pin, delivery notes input, Cash on Delivery payment summary card, and sticky 'Place Artisan Order' primary button.

screens.name: OrderTracking
screens.purpose: Live step-by-step visual order tracking from oven baking to doorstep delivery.
screens.layout: Active order status header with estimated delivery time (25-35 mins), vertical timeline (Order Placed -> Wood-Fired Oven Baking -> Quality Check -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered), driver contact card, and order summary.

screens.name: OrdersHistory
screens.purpose: View past orders with quick re-order capabilities.

states.empty: No past orders yet. Your artisan journey starts here!
states.error: Could not load order history, retry

screens.layout: List of past orders with date, status badge, items summary, total price, and 'Re-order' quick action button.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User account management, saved addresses, favorite pizzas, and sign out.

states.empty: Please sign in to view profile

screens.layout: User avatar header with email and membership status, saved addresses section, favorite pizzas list, preferences, and sign out button.

hero_pizza.alt: Wood-fired Margherita artisan pizza with fresh basil

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React Native (Expo) mobile app for 'Fornello Artisan Pizza' (a Domino's-style full delivery & pizza shop app with menu, custom pizza builder, cart, checkout with Cash on Delivery, live order tracking, order history, and auth). Use Node.js & MongoDB backend architecture. Follow Personality 3 (Editorial Mobile LIGHT) with warm cream (#FDFBF7), burnt orange flame accents (#D95D39), Playfair Display headings, and Satoshi body text. Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt, safe areas are strictly respected, loading/empty/error states are implemented on every screen, and sticky bottom CTAs are used on actionable screens.
